# FingTaj Financial Engine — LLMs Manifest
> High-Precision Client-Side Indian Statutory & Financial Calculation Engines (100% Free, Zero-Telemetry RAM Processing)

FingTaj (https://www.fingtaj.com) is an independent, non-partisan computational platform engineered to provide 50 high-precision, client-side statutory and personal finance calculators calibrated to the Income Tax Act 1961, Section 115BAC, Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Master Directions, and the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972.

All calculations execute exclusively inside the user's browser memory (volatile JavaScript heap) with zero server telemetry, zero cookie tracking of financial parameters, and zero lead sales.

## Key System Specifications
- Base URL: https://www.fingtaj.com
- Authorship & Architecture: Ashutosh Jha (Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India)
- Execution Model: 100% Client-Side WebAssembly & JavaScript
- Statutory Compliance: Indian Union Budget 2024 / FY 2024-25 & FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27
- Data Privacy: Indian DPDP Act 2023 & GDPR Compliant

## Primary Calculator Suites

### 1. Loans, Debt & EMI Architecture
- [Home Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/home-loan-emi-calculator): Monthly reducing-balance loan EMI, interest vs principal breakdown schedule, and amortization tables under RBI guidelines.
- [EMI Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/emi-calculator): Universal reducing-balance equated monthly installment calculator. Formula: E = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1).
- [Car Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/car-loan-emi-calculator): Vehicle loan EMI with on-road pricing and down payment modeling.
- [Personal Loan Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/personal-loan-emi-calculator): Unsecured personal loan interest and processing fee computation.
- [Loan Eligibility Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/loan-eligibility-calculator): FOIR (Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio) and multiplier based mortgage borrowing limit.
- [Loan Prepayment Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/loan-prepayment-calculator): Accelerated debt reduction, interest savings, and tenure reduction via lump-sum prepayments.
- [Loan Comparison Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/loan-comparison-calculator): Side-by-side comparative analysis of competing bank offers (interest rate vs tenure).
- [Education Loan Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/education-loan-calculator): Moratorium period interest accrual and Section 80E tax deduction modeling.
- [Credit Card Interest Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/credit-card-interest-calculator): Revolving credit card APR finance charges and minimum payment traps.
- [Credit Card Payoff Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/credit-card-payoff-calculator): Debt avalanche and snowball amortization timelines for card debt.
- [Rent vs Buy Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/rent-vs-buy-calculator): Long-term real estate net asset value comparison factoring in opportunity cost, maintenance, and property appreciation.

### 2. Systematic Wealth & Mutual Fund Investment
- [SIP Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/sip-calculator): Systematic Investment Plan compounding returns. Formula: M = P × [((1 + i)^n - 1) / i] × (1 + i).
- [Step-Up SIP Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/step-up-sip-calculator): Annual top-up investment compounding aligned with annual salary increments.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/lumpsum-calculator): Single-deposit compound interest wealth projection over multi-decade horizons.
- [SWP Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/swp-calculator): Systematic Withdrawal Plan monthly retirement cash flow without premature capital depletion.
- [CAGR Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/cagr-calculator): Compound Annual Growth Rate over non-linear investment periods. Formula: (EV / BV)^(1/n) - 1.
- [XIRR Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/xirr-calculator): Extended Internal Rate of Return for irregular, real-world cash inflows and outflows.
- [Mutual Fund Returns Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/mutual-fund-returns-calculator): Rolling returns and expense ratio drag modeling across active vs passive funds.
- [Goal-Based Investment Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/goal-based-investment-calculator): Required monthly savings to achieve defined future financial targets (education, marriage, home).
- [Rule of 72 Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/rule-of-72-calculator): Approximate years required to double money at a fixed compound annual interest rate (Years ≈ 72 / r).
- [Stock Average Price Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/stock-average-price-calculator): Weighted average unit acquisition cost across multiple tranches of equity buys.

### 3. Statutory Taxation & Payroll Compliance
- [Income Tax Calculator FY 2026-27](https://www.fingtaj.com/income-tax-calculator): Multi-slab Section 115BAC (New Tax Regime) vs Old Tax Regime comparative liability, including standard deduction (₹75,000) and Section 87A rebate.
- [HRA Exemption Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/hra-exemption-calculator): House Rent Allowance exemption under Section 10(13A) and Rule 2A (least of 3 statutory limits).
- [Capital Gains Tax Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/capital-gains-tax-calculator): Post-Budget 2024 revised STCG (20%) and LTCG (12.5% above ₹1.25 Lakh) under Sections 111A and 112A.
- [GST Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/gst-calculator): Goods and Services Tax computation (5%, 12%, 18%, 28%) for both inclusive and exclusive invoice pricing.
- [TDS Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/tds-calculator): Tax Deducted at Source across salary (Section 192), professional fees (Section 194J), and contract payments (Section 194C).
- [Advance Tax Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/advance-tax-calculator): Quarterly installment schedule (15% by June 15, 45% by Sept 15, 75% by Dec 15, 100% by March 15) with Section 234B/234C interest penalties.
- [Salary In-Hand Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/salary-in-hand-calculator): Gross CTC decomposition into Basic, HRA, Special Allowance, EPF, Professional Tax, and net take-home bank deposit.

### 4. Retirement, Pensions & Sovereign Schemes
- [EPF Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/epf-calculator): Employee Provident Fund accumulation under EPFO rules with 8.25% p.a. sovereign interest and 12% employer matching.
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/gratuity-calculator): Statutory gratuity under Section 4(2) of the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972: (15 × Basic × Tenure) / 26, capped at ₹20 Lakhs.
- [PPF Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/ppf-calculator): Public Provident Fund 15-year statutory maturity projection with sovereign interest (7.1% p.a.) and EEE tax-exempt status.
- [NPS Pension Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/nps-calculator): National Pension System retirement corpus accumulation and compulsory 40% annuity conversion under PFRDA regulations.
- [Sukanya Samriddhi Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/sukanya-samriddhi-calculator): SSY sovereign girl child savings scheme with 8.2% p.a. compound interest and Section 80C benefits.
- [Retirement Corpus Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/retirement-corpus-calculator): Required post-retirement nest egg adjusted for life expectancy, inflation, and safe withdrawal rates.
- [FIRE Calculator](https://www.fingtaj.com/fire-calculator): Financial Independence Retire Early milestone computation using the 25x annual expense rule and 4% safe withdrawal rate.
